verified_paths.name: MSDH Private Well Water Testing — bacteriological contamination only
verified_paths.notes: MSDH tests private wells for bacteriological contamination only. Testing for mineral content, chemicals or other contaminants should be done through a private laboratory. Sampling service for private water wells only — not for homes on public water systems (contact water supply operator or MSDH Bureau of Public Water Supply). Hub also at Private Wells index.cfm/30,0,76,762,html.

verified_paths.name: Apply online for private well water sampling and testing (Private Well Sample)
verified_paths.notes: Official online application: Department will take a sample from your well and test for bacteriological contamination; application is for a single well. Chemistry/minerals/other contaminants require a private lab — form links to In-State Participating Labs. Division of On-site Wastewater will not sample homes on public water systems.
